title: Fiscora
summary: Free financial calculators for small businesses: 20 tools in 10 languages, with live gold and silver prices and a finance dashboard on the way.

caseStudy.overview: Fiscora is our own product: a free set of financial calculators for small businesses, with a finance dashboard in pre-launch. Avora Digital designed, built and runs it, and we use it to test the same performance, multilingual and SEO practices we apply to client work.
caseStudy.challenge: Small business owners juggle margins, VAT, cash flow, zakat and gold prices across generic tools. Most of those tools are English-only and ignore local details: tola and karat for gold, silver or gold nisab for zakat, PKR and Gulf VAT, or the returns and courier costs that decide whether a cash-on-delivery store is actually profitable.
caseStudy.solution: We built 20 focused calculators that each do one job well, explain their formula in plain language, show a worked example and answer the common questions on the same page. The whole site is available in 10 languages, each on its own URL with hreflang, so every language version can be found in search. A blog adds practical guides for Pakistani businesses, such as COD pricing, zakat on gold and FBR salary tax.
features: 20 calculators: budget, profit margin, discount, commission, ROI, loan, break-even, VAT/GST, currency, salary, Pakistan salary tax, age, investment, cash flow, expense tracker, invoice, pricing, zakat, gold and e-commerce profit and loss
Every calculator explains its formula, includes a worked example and an FAQ
10 languages: English, Urdu and Arabic (right-to-left), Roman Urdu, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Hindi, German and Simplified Chinese, each with its own URL and hreflang tags
Live gold and silver prices that refresh every minute, with a manual override; currency conversion uses central bank reference rates, and users can type their own rate
Pakistan salary tax calculator using FBR slabs for tax years 2026-27 and 2025-26
Local detail: tola and karat for gold, silver or gold nisab for zakat, returns and courier costs for e-commerce
Privacy-first: figures typed into a calculator stay in the browser, and analytics only load after cookie consent
No account needed to use any calculator
caseStudy.status: All 20 calculators are live and free, and the blog publishes guides for Pakistani businesses. The finance dashboard is in pre-launch: plans from a free tier to $199 a month are published, and nothing can be purchased yet.

title: Peony
summary: A concept skincare store for the Pakistani market: 19 products across five ranges, a scroll-driven hero and a checkout built around cash on delivery.

caseStudy.overview: Peony is a concept build: a complete skincare store for a fictional Pakistani brand, designed and developed by Avora Digital to show how we would build a premium beauty store for this market. It is not a commissioned client project.
caseStudy.challenge: Beauty shoppers in Pakistan judge a new brand on two things before they buy: does it feel premium enough to trust with their skin, and can they pay safely. Most local stores either look like a template or hide delivery, payment and exchange details until checkout.
caseStudy.solution: We kept the range short and the store calm: a scroll-driven hero, a three-step ritual (cleanse, hydrate, renew) that tells shoppers where to start, and product cards that show size, price and texture at a glance. Trust details that Pakistani shoppers look for, such as cash on delivery, phone confirmation, delivery threshold and exchange policy, sit on every page instead of in the footer only.
features: 19 products across five ranges: skin, lips, eyes, body, and tools and sets
Scroll-driven hero that opens as the visitor scrolls
Product cards with size, price in PKR, badges and a texture view on hover
Quick add to bag from the shop page
A three-step ritual that guides first-time shoppers
Payment options built for Pakistan: cash on delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa and bank transfer
Delivery, exchange and order confirmation details on every page, plus WhatsApp support
caseStudy.status: Live as a concept demo. The brand and products are fictional.
